tools.name: Focustown
tools.blurb: Join a cozy virtual cafe or library and study next to real people in real time, with a focus timer and coins you earn to customize your character. Built around body-doubling (working alongside others), plus rewards like streaks. Mainly a mobile app (iOS and Android).
tools.firstStep: Download the app and join a study room with others.

tools.name: LifeAt
tools.blurb: Customizable virtual spaces with sounds and Pomodoro timers, plus to-do lists, a calendar that syncs with Google Calendar, and a notepad. Co-work with others through video, audio, and text chat. The cozy, aesthetic study room.
tools.firstStep: Create your first study space and invite a friend.

tools.name: Structured
tools.blurb: Combines a calendar, to-do list, and habit tracker in one visual timeline. Free version has an inbox for tasks without a time yet, sub-tasks, and a Pomodoro timer. Pro adds AI day-drafting and automatic rescheduling of missed tasks. Strongest for hour-by-hour planning.
tools.firstStep: Add your weekly schedule to the timeline view.

tools.name: Google Calendar
tools.blurb: Events, deadlines, and reminders that sync across devices and can be shared. Simple and fast, but not a study tool by itself.
tools.firstStep: Create a new calendar for school and add your next deadline.

tools.name: Notion
tools.blurb: A flexible workspace for notes, databases, project trackers, and dashboards. You build your own system, which is powerful but takes setup. Features and pricing may change.
tools.firstStep: Create a simple study dashboard with a to-do list and notes.

tools.name: Quizlet
tools.blurb: Flashcards, practice tests, and study modes for memorizing and self-testing. Great for subjects requiring memorization.
tools.firstStep: Create a flashcard set for your next test.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.blurb: An AI assistant that can explain topics, summarize notes, brainstorm, and make practice questions. Check your school's rules and age requirements first.
tools.firstStep: Ask it to explain a concept you're struggling with.
